description: Allow dashboard submit-work to succeed when operators provide only work type and request name by accepting empty structured items payloads on the API, with tests that document the prior rejection and lock in header-only submission behavior end to end.

context.customerAsk: When no text is in the submit-work submission payload, the UI submission fails. Add a test proving header/type-only submission is rejected today, then fix it so submission works with an empty text payload.
context.problem: The dashboard Submit work widget sends items: [] when blank text items are omitted, but backend structured submit-work validation rejects empty items arrays with 400 Bad Request even though OpenAPI only requires name and workTypeName.
context.solution: Relax pkg/api structured submit-work validation and conversion to accept items: [] as a valid header-only submission, keep rejecting whitespace-only non-empty item arrays, add explicit API and functional tests for the scenario, and verify the existing dashboard widget empty-payload submission path succeeds.

acceptanceCriteria: POST /work with name, workTypeName, and items: [] returns 201 Created with a trace identifier.
Header-only submissions reach the factory with the provided name and work type and empty structured content.
items arrays containing only whitespace text items still return 400 with a clear validation error.
The dashboard Submit work widget completes header-only submission without showing a server error.
API and functional tests cover header-only acceptance and prevent regression to empty-items rejection.
Quality gate: backend and frontend typecheck, lint, and relevant tests pass before merge.

userStories.title: Prove header-only structured submit-work is rejected today
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an API test that submits only name, workTypeName, and an empty items array so the current rejection is documented before we change validation.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /work with body containing non-empty name, configured workTypeName, and items: [] returns 400 Bad Request.
The error message identifies structured items validation such as items must contain at least one item.
The test name and assertions describe header/type-only submission without text or file payload content.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Accept header-only structured submit-work on the API
userStories.description: As a dashboard operator, I want to submit work with only a work type and request name so I can enqueue named requests without typing optional details.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /work with name, workTypeName, and items: [] returns 201 Created and a non-empty trace identifier.
The factory receives the submission with the provided name and workTypeName and with empty structured content.
items arrays that contain only whitespace text items still return 400 Bad Request with items must contain at least one non-empty item.
Prior rejection tests for empty items: [] are updated to expect success instead of failure.
A functional runtime API smoke test submits header-only structured work and observes successful acceptance.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Confirm the dashboard submit-work widget completes header-only submission
userStories.description: As a dashboard user, I want the Submit work widget to succeed when I fill in work type and request name but leave the default text item blank.
acceptanceCriteria: With work type and request name filled and the default text item left empty, clicking Submit work issues one POST whose JSON body includes items: [], the chosen name, and workTypeName.
When the API responds 201, the widget shows the existing success status message with the returned trace identifier.
No inline server error is shown for the header-only happy path.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
